title: serving-runtime-observability-integration-guidelines-metric-deck
summary: Working notes for integrating serving-runtime telemetry into the central observability stack. Focus: metric definitions that map to cost/latency SLOs, trace sampling budget for quantized model rollouts, and lightweight dashboard wireframes for oncall and release engineers.
goals: 1) Define a small, high-signal metric set that the serving-runtime team owns end-to-end. 2) Provide sampling & enrichment guidelines for traces that keep query costs bounded while preserving rollback fidelity for model rollouts. 3) Sketch operator-focused dashboards that surface cache-warmth, batching behavior, and per-tenant cost hotspots.
background: Serving-runtime has several new surface areas (quantized execution paths, aggressive KV cache prefetch, adaptive batching) that increase telemetry cardinality. We need compact contracts so observability can scale without ballooning query cost. These notes capture a proposal and suggested instrumentation keys for engineers implementing kernels, cache logic, and the routing layer.
metric_definitions:
-- Serve.latency.first_token_ms: p50/p90/p99, per-model, per-tenant, aggregation: histogram -> quantiles. Owner: eng-serving-runtime. Use for latency SLO and direct user-facing TTFB analyses.
-- Serve.latency.decode_ms_per_token: average decode time per token, per-model-arch, seq_len_bucket. Owner: perf.
-- KVCache.prefetch_hit_ratio: ratio(prefetch_hits / prefetch_requests) by tenant/model. Important for warm-start regressions.
-- Batch.effective_batch_size: distribution over requests batched together before dispatch. Use median + tails to tune max_batch_wait.
-- Model.variant.fallback_count: counts of automatic fallbacks (e.g., quantized->full) during capacity pressure. Tag with fallback_reason.
-- Cost.estimated_gpu_seconds: heuristic per-request GPU time estimate (used for tenant chargeback). Derived at acceptor point.
-- Cold_start_rate: fraction of requests where kv_cache_miss=true AND model_warm=false over 5m windows.
-- Inference.error_type: simple counter with labels (timeout, oom, model_mismatch, decode_error). Expose sample traces for error types.
(Instrumentation notes: prefer low-cardinality labels; use model_family + quant_level instead of full model hash.)
trace_sampling_plan:
Principles:
- Keep global trace sampling budget constant; allocate weighted samples across signals (rollouts, high-cost requests, errors).
- Always sample 100% of requests that trigger fallbacks or errors.
- Weighted sampling for high-cost requests: sample N per minute per model_family where N scales with observed cost (GPU_seconds).
- Probabilistic session sampling: sample 1% of sessions globally, but bias up to 10% for tenants with active rollouts.
Implementation sketch:
- Trace router component tags traces with 'trace_reason' (error, fallback, high_cost, rollout, sample_global).
- Sampling decision based on a token-bucket budget per region with backpressure signals to avoid exceeding retention quotas.
- Include minimal request context (tenant_id, model_family, seq_len_bucket) and a hashed prompt fingerprint for lightweight de-duplication.
Retention tiers:
- Full traces (7d) for errors and rollouts.
- Compact spans (14d indexes only) for weighted high-cost samples.
- Aggregate telemetry only (metrics) kept long-term (90/365d depending on billing).
dashboard_wireframes_notes:
Audience: oncall -> compact view; release engineer -> rollout slices.
Panels to include:
- Latency heatmap: x-axis = time, y-axis = model_variant; color = p99 first_token_ms. Quick filter by tenant.
- KVCache warmth panel: moving-window prefetch_hit_ratio, cold_start_rate, and per-tenant top cold keys.
- Batch sizing & queue time: stacked histogram of wait_ms before batch + effective_batch_size median/tail.
- Cost spotlight: rolling estimated_gpu_seconds by tenant (top 10) with trend sparkline.
- Rollout watch: model_variant.fallback_count + accompanying sampled traces link.
UX notes:
- Make every panel a 1-click drill into trace-router query with prefilled filters.
- Use 'tenancy mode' toggle to switch between aggregate multi-tenant and single-tenant contexts.
- Limit dashboard query range default to 15m for oncall, allow 1h/6h for triage.
rollout_checklist:
- Add instrumentation for fallback_count and prefetch metrics before canary.
- Wire sample hooks: ensure rollout tags propagate to trace router.
- Small-scale synthetic probe targeting model_variant at 5 RPM for 24h prior to canary.
- Pre-deploy dashboard snapshot: verify p99 first_token baseline and cold_start_rate baseline captured.
- Post-rollout: run quick regression scan comparing pre/post quantile deltas across key tenants.

open_questions:
- How many per-model high-cost samples/min are acceptable given retention budgets? (need finance input).
- Should we adopt a hashed tenant bucketing to reduce label cardinality at the metrics layer? Tradeoffs with per-tenant debugging.
- What SLA demands a 100% sampling for a tenant (enterprise vs self-serve)? Policy decision needed.
- Can we surface prompt fingerprints safely without leaking PII? Need security review.

notes_to_self: Keep the metric set intentionally small. Prioritize signals needed for rollback decisions (fallback_count, cold_start_rate, p99 first_token). Avoid adding per-prompt labels. Revisit after one quarter of rollouts to iterate sampling weights.
